mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the sensor and muscle routes was most worthwhile because it brought the pieces together around the familiar action of keeping your eyes on one point.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the turning sensors to the balance nerves felt less interesting on its own; it was a necessary link but didn't show the whole response yet.

surprise.text: The weighted layer shifts not just with tilt but also when straight-line movement changes.

arbitrary.text: Attaching the weighted sensors to the already connected turning sensors wasn't obvious to me after the balance nerves were consumed. The compatibility hint clarified the next step.

continue.text: I would continue: building the sensors and seeing how they help keep the eyes steady made me curious about other everyday body responses.
